cli: --run SAFE_ID --phase PHASE --family FAMILY --profile PROFILE [--storage hdd-v1] (four ordered pairs mandatory; only the terminal HDD pair is optional; no defaults/help/root/env/cwd selector)
receiptApproval: Each predecessor receipt must be independently selected by main in main-approval.json.receipts; CLI takes no caller expected-hash argument. A local owner/approval marker is a trusted-main filesystem input, NOT a cryptographic signature or security capability.
toolchain: Main-owned tools root contains regular bin/pnpm and node_modules/pnpm/package.json version10.13.1. Current Node must be24.22.0 with approved actual binary digest. No arbitrary command/executable from request.
toolchainConfinement: Invoke CLI using the main-owned regular tools/bin/node. PATH is only tools/bin; main-approved toolchain-inputs.json pins the Node/pnpm executable and complete pnpm implementation. No Corepack resolution or ambient npm config. Empty owned HOME user/global configs and isolated cache/store are required.
checkout: producer-checkout.json is a main-reviewed-fresh-detached-real-checkout receipt binding root and40-character revision to request.selectedRevision and actual regular .git/HEAD. Producer dependency provisioning is main-owned; map uses canonical regular paths, not node_modules symlink spellings.
native: bundle and family-build require separately approved native-inputs-FAMILY-PROFILE.json, status=main-reviewed-provisioned-local-native-files, key and nonempty files map. No install lifecycle or native provisioning is automatic.
preparation: Validate target and BOTH real sealed archives before creating target. Ordinary is fresh standalone; explicit profiles require separate main-manual preparation/asset/config receipt and never automatically stage/register a patch.
historical: CURRENT_PUBLIC_GENERATION remainsfc01; original180/fc01 and historical199 failure characterization are never generated, rewritten or approved by this harness.

limits.purpose: parser safety limits, not bundle/performance budgets

runtimeHold: Family build/source staging is authored. Family runtime throws an explicit hold for separately selected real HTTP/Flight/stream/browser/native runner; it cannot return a success marker. Port6575, strict serialized, reuseExistingServer=false.
securityLimit: No OS sandbox or defense against a hostile same-user process/concurrent filesystem replacement. Exclusive writes, no-follow reads and repeated realpath/hash guards are best effort.
execution: All production helpers, CLI, filesystem adversaries, installs, emission, archives, framework/consumer/negative/dual/runtime/CI remain UNRUN during authoring. Drag/G-02 blocked.

storageFollowup.legacy: Exact original eight arguments select legacy-ssd roots above; controls with storage fields are rejected. Historical receipts/maps are not re-signed.
storageFollowup.selector: Only terminal --storage hdd-v1; explicit main phase/controls still required; never automatic fallback
storageFollowup.roles: Same wp13-run-ID, wp13-producer-ID, wp13-tools-ID, wp13-consumer-ID-FAMILY-PROFILE basenames inside namespace; consumer absent before prepare
storageFollowup.leaseFile: namespace/storage-lease.json; read-only main-created immutable regular0600 single-link control; namespace/run/producer/tools0700, effective UID
storageFollowup.physicalIdentity: parent/namespace/roles.run/roles.producer/roles.tools: exact {dev,ino,uid}, nonnegative safe integers captured from actual stat; roles must share namespace and parent device
storageFollowup.rootsShape: Exact {parent,namespace,run,producer,tools,consumers}; consumers contains all ten valid FAMILY-PROFILE keys, each with the derived absolute target
storageFollowup.controlBinding: owner.json, request.json and main-approval.json each require identical storage={layout:hdd-v1,leaseSHA256,roots}. Approval also requires storageReceiptBindings[NAME]={leaseSHA256,sha256}, with exact approval.receipts key set and actual receipt hashes. Missing fields fail closed.
storageFollowup.inputBinding: Lease's four input hashes must equal actual regular input maps AND approval.receipts entries. Control/receipt physical identity, bytes and stat stamps captured once and rechecked; source revision/candidate must match request.
storageFollowup.consumerBinding: prepare adds storage={layout,leaseSHA256,root,identity:{dev,ino,uid}} to both wp13-owner.json and consumer-prepared-KEY.json; later reads require exact match and approved prepared receipt, actual root identity/owner/device; installed receipt carries full storage provenance
storageFollowup.scratch: HDD only: owned0700 run/home/KEY/.cache/tmp is TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP; run/home/KEY/.cache is XDG_CACHE_HOME. Fixed home, key, cache and tmp identities are pinned before/after children; no ambient temp inheritance.
storageFollowup.provenance: New generation/installed/phase/failure records carry storage={layout,leaseSHA256,roots,parent,namespace,roles}. Frozen other receipt schemas remain unchanged and are bound by main's storageReceiptBindings, not retroactively relabelled.
storageFollowup.limits: Trusted main local filesystem lease only, not application/backend/P authority, cryptographic approval, real-checkout proof, hostile same-user sandbox or package G-05 approval. Source checks cannot select actual HDD guard tests/provisioning/materialization.
